Featured — Flagship Dossier

Asked Point Blank: Becerra’s “Black Agenda” Answer

“I’m not going to promise you 40 acres and a mule.”

Tavis Smiley asked Xavier Becerra — running for Governor of California — for his Black agenda, point blank, on KBLA Talk 1580. That was the headline of his answer. The only concrete example in it? Cash bail. But in his own written questionnaire, he’d promised 10,000 descendant families a path to homeownership. Mae put the tape, the transcript, the paper plan, and the missing reparations number in one file.
